name: oracle_hard
description: HARDER oracle fixture (R4-R7), authored from real archolith/menhir history to stress the cases the easy demo could not: (1) high-support-but-stale items a linear sum keeps but role-separation suppresses; (2) cross-repo scope collisions where a wrong-repo memory shares heavy topic/structure overlap with the query (menhir/archolith-bench/subgraph-code/archolith-context/archolith-maintenance); (3) multiple real rename trails plus the yawn.scheduler trap (a real component, NOT the old project name); (4) buried-by-embedding recovered by structure. Still a DRAFT smoke fixture, not headline numbers; semantic signal is a lexical stand-in.

memories.text: Recall applies a source-aware similarity floor so BM25 and facet candidates survive; hybrid fuses on rank with weighted_rrf.
The recall similarity floor is a fixed 0.15 cosine MIN_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD that gates every candidate in the scoring service.
An agent guessed the similarity floor threshold might be around 0.2 in the scoring service.
menhir scheduler_lease force_acquire overwrites the single-leader scheduler lease even when the previous lease is still active.
The single-leader SchedulerLeaseStore scheduler lease lives in archolith-maintenance (Phase 0.5).
The package is menhir: src/menhir, console script menhir serve, env vars MENHIR_ prefixed.
The project was renamed from cth.mcp.memory to yawn_memory.
archolith-memory references were updated to menhir across the context proxy.
yawn.scheduler manages the local llama.cpp OpenAI-compatible endpoint lifecycle for single-flight ingestion.
In subgraph-code a file is a one-way projection rendered on demand from the content-addressed function graph; the graph is the only source of truth.
menhir stores long-lived memory in a Neo4j plus Graphiti graph with deferred enrichment.
The archolith-context proxy ships as python package archolith_proxy and rebuilds a smaller graph-assembled context window per upstream call.
The archolith-bench facet baselines fuse BM25 and embedding rankings with reciprocal rank fusion.
menhir Neo4j defaults bolt://localhost:7687 and password 'password' are unsafe for anything beyond localhost.
The menhir Neo4j default password posture was remediated and is now safe by default.
The CE willow leafless-immature bug was resolved by the load-order fix.
The patch fully fixed the CE willow leafless issue.
Combat Extended config tweak adjusting immature tree growth limits.
archolith-maintenance Phase 0.5 adds single-leader election for the scheduler.
archolith-maintenance renews the scheduler lease with a heartbeat before expiry.
archolith-maintenance lease rows carry a TTL so a dead leader's lease expires.
subgraph-code mints a new function node directly into the content-addressed graph.
subgraph-code flags a function node as orphaned when it loses all callers.
subgraph-code identifies each function node by a content-addressed hash of its body.
The archolith-context proxy ships an archolith-filter extra for token reduction.
The archolith-context proxy ships an archolith-audit extra for waste monitoring.
The archolith-context proxy extracts session facts and traces upstream calls.
